outline:
本課程旨在為學生奠定商業統計基礎，並闡述其在數據驅動決策中的作用。學生將學習如何收集、整理、視覺化和分析商業數據，解讀統計結果，並使用 Microsoft Excel 和 SPSS 進行數據分析和結果交流。課程著重透過商業案例研究和真實案例進行實踐應用。
This course provides students with a foundation in business statistics and its role in data-driven decision-making. Students will learn to collect, organize, visualize, and analyze business data, interpret statistical results, and communicate findings using Microsoft Excel and SPSS. The course emphasizes practical applications through business case studies and real-world examples.
schedule:
Week 1 Introduction to Business Statistics
Week 2 Business Data & Data Collection
Week 3 Organizing & Visualizing Data
Week 4 Descriptive Statistics I (Mean, Median, Mode)
Week 5 Descriptive Statistics II (Variation & Distribution)
Week 6 Business Dashboard & Report Writing
Week 7 Introduction to Probability
Week 8 Probability in Business
Week 9 Midterm Examination
Week 10 Probability Distributions
Week 11 Normal Distribution
Week 12 Sampling Methods
Week 13 Sampling Distributions
Week 14 Confidence Intervals
Week 15 Business Decision Making
Week 16 Group Statistical Exhibit
Week 17 Sample Project Creation Course
Week 18 Wrap-up & Final Examination

category: 學生分組實作及討論(Student group practice and discussion)
參與課程相關作業、作品、實驗、田野調查(Participation in course-related assignments, works, experiments, or field research)
flexible_learning.content: The course covers the fundamentals of business statistics, including data collection, data organization and visualization, descriptive statistics, probability, probability distributions, normal distribution, sampling methods, sampling distributions, and confidence intervals. Practical applications are emphasized through business case studies, Excel and SPSS exercises, dashboard and report writing, and a group statistical project and presentation.
flexible_learning.outcome: By the end of this course, students will be able to understand and apply fundamental statistical concepts to business problems, organize and visualize data, interpret descriptive statistics and probability, use sampling and estimation techniques, and perform basic statistical analysis using Excel and SPSS. Students will also develop the ability to interpret results, make evidence-based business decisions, and communicate their findings clearly through reports and presentations.
